blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-security-1 (Path traversal in read_attachment through the client-supplied name) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.recommendation: The authorization check covers only ticket_id; name comes from the client and is joined as is (CWE-22). An agent allowed to read one ticket asks for name="../17/contract.pdf" and reads another team's ticket attachment, or name="../../../../etc/passwd" (or the absolute "/etc/passwd", which makes os.path.join discard the base) and reads any file the service can read, helpdesk.db included. Validate name at the boundary: reject anything that differs from os.path.basename(name), "." and "..", then look the name up in the attachments table for that ticket_id (only stored names are readable), and as defence in depth check that os.path.realpath(path) stays under the ticket's directory. Add a test reading "../<other ticket>/<file>" and an absolute path, both refused.
findings.title: Path traversal in read_attachment through the client-supplied name

findings.evidence:
def save_attachment(ticket_id: int, filename: str, data: bytes) -> str:
    """Stores an uploaded file under the ticket's directory; returns its name."""
    name = os.path.basename(filename)
    directory = os.path.join(UPLOAD_DIR, str(ticket_id))
findings.recommendation: Unlike read_attachment, save_attachment takes no agent_id and checks no permission, so the server-side authorization for the upload operation depends entirely on a caller this change does not show (no handler calls it yet). If the upload endpoint passes the request's ticket_id straight through, any authenticated agent can attach files to, or overwrite an existing same-name attachment of, another team's ticket (CWE-862). Take the agent_id and check may_read_ticket (or a write permission) as read_attachment does, and do not silently overwrite an existing file.
findings.title: save_attachment writes to any ticket without an authorization check
